text_fr: Le PRESIDENT met au vote la question de savoir si la Cour doit comprendre vingt cinq juges. Le Comité, à mains levées, répond négativement.
text_en: The PRESIDENT put to the vote the question as to whether the Court should be composed of twenty five judges. The motion was rejected by the Committee by a show of hands.

text_fr: Le PRESIDENT met au vote la proposition de composer la Cour de onze juges et de quatre suppléants.
text_en: The PRESIDENT then put to the vote the proposal that the Court should be composed of eleven judges and four deputy judges.

text_fr: Cette proposition est adoptée à mains levées.
text_en: This proposal was adopted by a show of hands.

text_fr: Le PRESIDENT met au vote la proposition de fixer à neuf ans la durée du mandat des juges. Cette proposition est adoptée à mains levées.
text_en: The PRESIDENT put to the vote the proposal that the judges should be appointed for a period of nine years.
This proposal was also adopted by a show of hands.
